mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp in 3 months does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% in 1 month does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month does not correlate with a strong labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 10% in 2 months does not correlate with weakening housing demand.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 negative for 2 consecutive quarters does not correlate with economic contraction.
